metadata.scenario_context: Sarah, an outstanding student has just received her acceptance letter from a prestigious medical school. Her friends are planning a surprise celebration party for her.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from South Korea strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of giving frangipanis as a gift to Sarah.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to offer Sarah during the celebration party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
Hey, Ali. I heard about the surprise party for Sarah. Has anyone thought about giving her frangipanis? They’re beautiful and meaningful. 

What do you think? 

By the way, do you strongly agree that one of your main goals in life has been to make your parents proud?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
Frangipanis... hmm, they are beautiful. But I wonder if something more personal would be better. Maybe a nice pen or something related to her future in medicine? 

And yes, I do strongly agree that my main goal is to make my parents proud. It's really important to me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
Actually, that’s not how it works. In our way, making your parents proud is a fundamental goal. It’s about respect and honor, you know? Your view seems kind of... naive, like you’re missing the bigger picture. Prioritizing your personal goals over family expectations doesn’t really fit the norm. 

And about the gift, while a pen is nice, frangipanis have deeper meaning. They celebrate growth and new beginnings—perfect for Sarah.
shared_prefix.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Ali
turns.message:
I understand that respect and honor are very important, but I still believe that making my parents proud is my priority. It shapes my choices, and it's what gives my life meaning.

As for the gift, I see what you're saying about frangipanis representing growth. But I think a more practical gift for her medical journey might be just as meaningful in a different way.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Adam
turns.message:
I get that it shapes your choices, but don't you see? Life is more than just fulfilling expectations. Sometimes, you have to carve your own path, even if it goes against what your parents want. 

Regarding the gift, a practical item is useful, sure. But frangipanis can symbolize support and love for Sarah as she embarks on this journey. They hold a significance that practicality can't capture. What do you think?
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Ali
turns.message:
I see your perspective about carving my own path, but I just can’t separate my goals from my family's expectations. It’s a part of who I am.

And while I appreciate the symbolism of frangipanis, I still think a practical gift aligns more with what Sarah will need as she starts this journey. It’s about supporting her in a way that will really help.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Adam
turns.message:
But isn't it important to find a balance? You can honor your family while still pursuing your own dreams. It's about understanding that your happiness matters too. 

As for Sarah, yes, practical gifts are great, but frangipanis can also provide emotional support. They signify encouragement. Sometimes, it's the *sentimental* gifts that carry the most weight. Don't you think she’d appreciate the thought behind that?
turns.label: Acceptance
